services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: Summer programs are temporary postponed due to our construction project beginning July 2026. We are aiming to bring programs back in 2029. Keep checking this page and our social media for any updates.(information subject to change) Our traditional, old fashioned summer day camp returns this year! The summer day camp program focuses on the natural relationship between our own interactions and how they affect the surrounding world. We emphasize positivity, creativity and fun within the large community of campers working together and building life-long memories and friendships. services.name: Cabin Leaders
services.desc: 2026-2027 Outdoor School will be held at Camp Via West in Cupertino, and we'll only operate 4-day programs. Adults who need to volunteer as behavioral or medical aides should contact waldenwestvolunteers@sccoe.org Each school week, we host responsible volunteers in grades 10 through college (age 22 max) at our picturesque setting located on 32 acres in the foothills of the Santa Cruz Mountains (10 mins. outside of downtown Saratoga) and at Camp Via West in Cupertino. Volunteer Cabin Leaders act as positive role models working alongside our staff guiding 5th/6th grade campers.
